abstracts.abstract: By Representative Arena-DeRosa of Holliston, a petition (accompanied by bill, House, No. 5526) of James C. Arena-DeRosa (by vote of the town) that the town of Holliston be authorized to establish a means-tested senior citizen property tax exemption for debt exclusion construction projects.  Revenue.  [Local Approval Received.]

bill.title: An Act authorizing the town of Holliston to establish a means-tested senior citizen property tax exemption for debt exclusion construction projects

action.description: Bill reported favorably by committee and referred to the committee on House Steering, Policy and Scheduling
